note: Credit packs (Leagues part 2, behind LEAGUES_PRO), bought with real money on the league pages only, labelled "for Pro Leagues". $1 = 1 credit. The id is the product id in every store: Stripe on the web, App Store and Google Play in-app purchases (consumable; in Google Play written with _ instead of -: credits_5). amountCents: the website price; storeAmountCents: the US price in App Store Connect and Play Console (each store sets other countries itself). Credits never expire; they can be swapped into coins (1,000 a credit), never coins into credits.

packs.line: 2 Pro Leagues, or a Pro pass

description: Credits for Pro Leagues in Marble Spins. Credits never expire. They can be swapped into coins, but coins can't be swapped into credits.
